design_slices.implementation_directive: Create stdlib-only `scripts/workflow_evidence.py` (with atomic JSON persistence under `.codegraphcontext/workflow-state/`) defining typed models and pure functions for: (a) recording changed-path sets, (b) computing validation/commit evidence digests over content hashes, validator configs, `uv.lock`, Python minor version, validator identity, and selectors, (c) tracking per-backend/per-scope discovery freshness (`current`, `stale`, `unverifiable`), and (d) building `repo_local_tool_env()` isolating `HOME`, `XDG_*`, `UV_CACHE_DIR`, `SEMBLE_CACHE_LOCATION`, and CodeGraph paths to `.codegraphcontext/`. Add unit tests covering hash invalidation, atomic state updates, and zero `~/.codegraphcontext` path resolution.
design_slices.title: Shared Workflow Evidence, Freshness State, and Repo-Local Tool Env

design_slices.implementation_directive: Refactor `scripts/hook_posttool_edit_validation.py` so `run_posttool_request()` only records changed repo-local paths and marks affected discovery backends/scopes `stale` via `scripts/workflow_evidence.py`, with zero technical validator (`ruff`, `pyright`, docstring) invocations and zero synchronous `hook_refresh_indexes.py` calls. Add regression tests proving temporarily inconsistent multi-file intermediate edits record zero validator failures and mark the exact affected scopes stale.
design_slices.title: Decouple PostToolUse Edit Tracking from Validation and Synchronous Refresh

design_slices.implementation_directive: Update `scripts/edit_code.py` so `validate` and `sync` share one validation engine enforcing `ruff`, `pyright`, `validate_python_docstrings.py`, targeted `pytest`, and required docs checks; remove `--skip-ruff` and `--skip-pyright` bypass paths from closeout (`sync`); consult and persist `scripts/workflow_evidence.py` records so an unchanged validated state runs each mandatory validator at most once; verify and refresh any remaining stale discovery scopes before handoff; and emit commit evidence for staged/committed paths. Add unit and integration tests covering evidence reuse, invalidation on content/config/dependency/selector changes, and 100% closeout rejection on failing checks or unverifiable discovery state.
design_slices.title: Consolidate Optional Validate and Unskippable Closeout Sync in edit_code.py

design_slices.implementation_directive: Update `scripts/read_code_health.py`, `scripts/read_code.py`, and `scripts/hook_refresh_indexes.py` to enforce freshness on authoritative reads (`context`, `find`, `analyze`): skip refresh when affected scopes are `current` (zero duplicate refreshes on repeated reads), refresh only stale affected scopes before returning results, mark refreshed scopes `current`, and fail closed with captured `stderr` (never labeling stale data authoritative) if refresh fails. Ensure non-authoritative `window` reads never trigger refreshes. Add unit and live-backend verification tests covering SC-003 and SC-004.
design_slices.title: On-Demand Discovery Freshness on Authoritative Reads

design_slices.implementation_directive: Update `scripts/git_pre_commit_lint.py` and `scripts/git_post_commit_refresh.py` to verify staged/committed content and config hashes against persisted evidence in `scripts/workflow_evidence.py`: skip duplicate `ruff` or refresh only on exact verified match, and execute full safeguards whenever evidence is missing, stale, corrupt, or mismatched (preserving direct Git commit safety). Add regression tests covering both direct commits without evidence and governed commits with matching or mismatched evidence (SC-006).
design_slices.title: Evidence-Aware Git Commit Fallback Safeguards

design_slices.implementation_directive: Update `scripts/bootstrap_session.py` and `scripts/cgc_safe_index.py` (plus discovery subprocess calls in `scripts/read_code.py` and `scripts/hook_refresh_indexes.py`) to: (a) skip `cgc_safe_index.py` across `WARM_SCOPES` when `codegraph_health_probe` already reports healthy and no scopes are stale, (b) aggregate failures across all scopes so a later succeeding scope never overwrites an earlier failure, (c) surface actual subprocess `stderr` in `codegraph_detail`, and (d) run all CodeGraph/discovery subprocesses with `repo_local_tool_env()` so `~/.codegraphcontext` is never accessed. Add regression tests (including a sandboxed/restricted-HOME test) verifying SC-008.
design_slices.title: Fix bootstrap_session Health Gate, Failure Aggregation, and Repo-Local CGC Isolation

reasoning.build pipeline: Consolidates PostToolUse hooks, edit_code.py validate/sync, and git pre-commit/post-commit hooks into one coherent validation and refresh pipeline.
reasoning.caching: Defines content-, config-, dependency-, and test-selection-bound validation evidence reuse/invalidation and discovery staleness tracking.
reasoning.code patterns: Eliminates duplicated validation and refresh orchestration across hooks and scripts while keeping one canonical owner per responsibility.
reasoning.environment: Isolates codegraphcontext, read_code.py, bootstrap_session.py, and related local research tools to repo-local paths with zero user-home (~/.codegraphcontext) access.
reasoning.ops governance: Enforces unskippable mandatory closeout checks, preserves commit-time fallback safeguards, and aligns workflow documentation with a single owner per seam.
reasoning.testing: Requires regression coverage across multi-file intermediate edits, closeout rejection, stale authoritative reads, direct-commit safeguards, and bootstrap failure/isolation checks.
